CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MANAGER / PROJECT BUILDER
EZZI BUILDING SERVICES PTY LTD
PERTH WESTERN AUSTRALIA 6036
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: FULL-TIME PERMANENT
SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM

Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is seeking suitably qualified and experienced applicants for the positions of Construction Project Manager and Project Builder in Perth, Western Australia. The successful applicant will be responsible for managing residential and/or commercial construction projects from planning through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to a high standard of workmanship.

Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for overseeing construction projects, coordinating labour and subcontractors, liaising with clients, suppliers and consultants, and ensuring compliance with Australian building standards, workplace health and safety
requirements and company procedures.
The role requires strong project management capability, practical building knowledge and the ability to supervise works across multiple stages of construction.

Tasks
Key tasks include:
• Planning, coordinating and managing construction projects from commencement to completion.
• Preparing and reviewing project schedules and project plans, construction programs, budgets and work plans.
• Supervising site activities and coordinating trades, subcontractors and suppliers.
• Monitoring project progress, costs, materials, labour and quality of work.
• Interpreting plans, drawings, specifications and building documentation.
• Liaising with clients, architects, engineers, certifiers, local authorities and other stakeholders.
• Ensuring all work complies with relevant building codes, Australian standards, safety regulations and contractual requirements.
• Managing variations, delays, defects, site issues and project reporting.
• Conducting site inspections and ensuring quality control throughout the construction process.
• Maintaining accurate project records, reports, schedules and compliance documentation.

Skills
Applicants should have:
• Strong knowledge of construction methods, project delivery and site management.
• Excellent organisational, planning and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage budgets, timelines, subcontractors and construction resources.
• Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.
• Strong communication and negotiation skills.
• Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Proficiency with construction project management systems, scheduling tools and Microsoft Office or similar software.

Qualifications
Applicants must hold relevant qualifications in building, construction management, project management, civil construction, or a related field.
Relevant Australian or overseas qualifications may be considered, including a diploma, advanced diploma, bachelor degree or equivalent trade/background experience in the building and construction industry.

Experience
Applicants must have relevant experience in construction project management, building supervision or project delivery, if a bachelor's degree is present. If no degree, then at least 5 years of experience in the relevant industry.
Previous experience in residential, commercial or mixed-use construction projects will be highly regarded. Experience managing subcontractors, construction schedules, budgets, compliance requirements and client communications is essential.
Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM

Target Business Services

Position:		Full Time – Permanent
Location: 		6/14 Mason Street Cannington WA 6107
Salary: 			$97,500 Plus 12% Superannuation

Our client, Red Steel Works Pty Ltd. is a prominent Perth based company that specializes in providing reliable and high-quality steel fixing, formwork, precast labor, and scaffolding services for a diverse range of civil, industrial, commercial, and residential projects across Perth and Western Australia.

The client is currently recruiting experienced Formwork Carpenters with a solid background working on residential/ commercial projects to work at the multiple sites.

As a highly motivated and qualified Formwork Carpenter you will require strong technical knowledge of the building and construction industry combined with a high level of attention to detail.  

Minimum Requirements:

AQF Certificate III in relevant trade including 2 years on job training or AQF Certificate IV. At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications. The position requires at least one year of full -time experience and the ability to work independently to specifications and plans.  

What you will be responsible for:

-	Execute quality formwork carpentry workmanship to the highest level, whilst maintaining our company standards and safety 
-	Read plans and specifications to determine the dimensions, materials required and installation processes to be followed
-	Select appropriate materials for formwork construction, considering factors such as load-bearing capacity, durability, and reusability
-	Create formwork that matches the desired shape and dimensions of concrete structures
-	Interpret plans/engineering and project specifications to meet exacting standards 
-	Construct and repair structural woodwork and equipment from blueprints and oral instructions 
-	Install formwork on-site, pouring concrete into the formwork, and then removing the formwork after the concrete has cured
-	Maintain tools and machinery in safe and efficient operating condition
-	Prepare drawings and sketches of construction and repair projects
-	Estimate costs and orders materials needed.
-	Cut materials, and assemble and nail cut and shaped parts
-	Ensure compliance with relevant building codes, safety standards, and regulations
-	Liaise with clients, other trades in a professional manner
-	Adhere to safety regulations and protocols to maintain a safe working environment
Skills, experience and attributes:
-	Able to read and work from plans
-	Proficiency in carpentry techniques such as cutting, shaping, and joining wood or other materials to construct formwork accurately
-	Ability to manage multiple tasks
-	Must have vast experience in civil formwork, carpentry and be skilled in the use of hand and power tools
-	Ability to troubleshoot and solve problems that may arise during formwork construction
-	Demonstrate an understanding of, and commitment to OH&S principles
-	Able to work unsupervised

The Successful Applicant

You would be required to work in a team environment and would be expected to take on a variety of tasks. You would be required to work at times under pressure and timelines and be available to work in different areas if and when the need arises. The applicant must have an OHS white card and previous experience, preferably in the construction industry.

Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.
To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au.

Full-time Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in NSW.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Fire Protection Equipment Technician
•	Salary Range: $90,000 - $105,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Essential Passive Fire Protection Services Pty Ltd is a proudly Australian-owned and operated company dedicated to delivering premier facility maintenance and safety solutions. We specialise in comprehensive fire protection services, ensuring that commercial, industrial, and residential properties remain safe, compliant, and fully operational. Our commitment to excellence, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety forms the foundation of our operations, enabling us to provide unparalleled service to our diverse client base.

About the role
The Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician is responsible for ensuring that all passive fire containment systems are correctly installed, inspected, tested, and maintained in strict compliance with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and applicable Australian Standards, primarily AS 1851. The role involves working with a variety of passive fire systems, including but not limited to fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Install, repair, and maintain passive fire containment systems, including fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire/smoke doors, and shutters.
•	Ensure all installations and maintenance works are executed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, the BCA, and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Select and apply appropriate fire-stopping materials for various penetrations and construction joints.
•	Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance testing of passive fire protection systems in accordance with AS 1851.
•	Assess the integrity of fire compartments, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.
•	Identify, diagnose, and report on defects, non-conformances, or compromised fire separations.
•	Perform necessary rectification and repair works on non-compliant passive fire systems to restore full regulatory compliance.
•	Provide technical recommendations for the upgrade or replacement of obsolete or irreparably damaged passive fire infrastructure.
•	Accurately complete and submit service reports, logbooks, defect notices, and compliance certificates in a timely manner.
•	Maintain comprehensive digital and physical records of all inspections, tests, and rectification works using the company’s designated field service management software.
•	Capture and upload clear photographic evidence of pre- and post-rectification works.
•	Ensure the correct use, maintenance, and storage of all Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), tools, and company vehicles.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive understanding of the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and AS 1851 as they relate to passive fire protection.
•	Ability to read, interpret, and work from architectural drawings, engineering plans, and fire matrix schedules.
•	High level of attention to detail and precision in workmanship.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex compliance issues on-site.
•	Proficiency in using mobile technology (tablets/smartphones) and field service management software for reporting and documentation.
•	Excellent time management skills with the capacity to work autonomously and manage a daily schedule of site visits.
•	Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Certificate III level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White card

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $90,000-$105,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

The Opportunity
Join the School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. You will contribute to research and teaching in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with a focus on learning paradigms, models, and architectures for electronic learning systems. You will also teach across undergraduate and postgraduate Electrical Engineering programs and undertake research in machine learning, artificial intelligence, electronic systems, complex adaptive systems, and related emerging technologies.

Position Details
• Salary:
o Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $133,065 to $156,864 per annum + 17% superannuation
o Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $161,619 to $185,422 per annum + 17% superannuation
• Employment type: Full-time
• Appointment type: Fixed term, 2-year convertible tenure track (Fixed-term appointment with the potential to convert to continuing employment, subject to a successful review.)
• Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia
• Reporting line: This role reports to the Head of School and has no direct reports.

About You
You are an academic with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, learning systems, or a closely related area, with the ability to contribute to high-quality research and teaching. You are committed to advancing your research profile while delivering engaging learning experiences in the fundamentals, practice, and future directions of artificial intelligence and machine learning for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

Success in this role requires a collaborative and adaptable approach, with the ability to work across disciplines, build relationships with industry and professional networks, and contribute to the continued development of the School’s research capability in learning systems. At Senior Lecturer level, you will also bring evidence of research leadership, a nationally recognised research track record, success in attracting competitive funding, and experience mentoring colleagues and supervising higher degree research students to completion.

About UNSW
UNSW is a leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige and impact. With strong industry engagement, it translates academic expertise into real-world outcomes. The School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications is recognised for excellence in teaching and research.

Skills and Experience
Level B
• A PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related discipline, along with relevant work experience.
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
• Demonstrated experience and evidence in teaching and learning design, development and/or delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels in the fundamentals, practice, and future directions of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
• Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
• Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable).
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
• Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
• A track record of significant involvement with the profession and/or industry.
• High level communication skills and ability to network effectively and interact with a diverse range of students and staff.
• Demonstrated ability to work in a team, related to the future of machine learning such as mathematics, electronic systems, complex adaptive systems, etc.; and build effective relationships.
• Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
• An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
• Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Level C
• A PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related discipline, along with relevant work experience.
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
• Demonstrated experience and evidence in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level in the fundamentals, practice, and future directions of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
• Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
• Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement.
• Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning.
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
• Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
• Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students.
• Demonstrated ability to work in a team, related to the future of machine learning such as mathematics, electronic systems, complex adaptive systems, etc.; and build effective relationships.
• Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
• Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
• An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
• Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description.

To Apply: 
Please click “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter and responses to the Skills and Experience. Candidates may also include a ROPE statement.
https://external-careers.jobs.unsw.edu.au/cw/en/job/541600/lecturer-senior-lecturer-in-learning-systems

Please note applications will not be accepted if sent to the contact listed below.
Contact:
For role-specific inquiries, please contact Prof Jinhong Yuan (Head of School)
E: j.yuan@unsw.edu.au 

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Eugene Aves (Talent Acquisition Consultant)
E: eugene.aves@unsw.edu.au
 
Applications close: 11:50 pm (Sydney time) Friday, 28 August 2026

As part of our recruitment process candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening, which may include reference checks, qualification verification, right-to-work verification, and criminal history screening where relevant to the role.

UNSW is committed to evolving a culture that embraces equity and supports a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can participate fairly, in a safe and respectful environment. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage applications from people of diverse gender, orientation, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander background, people with disability and those with caring and family responsibilities. UNSW provides workplace adjustments for people with disability, and access to flexible work options for eligible staff. The University reserves the right not to proceed with any appointment.

 Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will join a close-knit maintenance team consisting of Maintenance Fitters and a Maintenance Manager who oversees day-to-day operations. 
 Working across rotating shifts, you'll play a key role in ensuring production equipment operates safely and efficiently while supporting the installation and commissioning of a new manufacturing line. 
   
 Hours:

 37.5 hours per week

 6:00am - 2:00pm

 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Carry out preventative and scheduled maintenance on manufacturing equipment

 Experience with preventative maintenance programmes

 Highly Desirable 
 
 Food manufacturing experience

 What's on Offer? 
 
 Permanent full-time employment

 Long-term career growth with a successful manufacturing business

About the company

Zimmermann Industries is a leading Australian signage, branding and corporate identity specialist, established in 2007. The company delivers end-to-end solutions, managing every stage from concept and design through to fabrication, installation and maintenance. With strong foundations in traditional signwriting and advanced expertise in custom architectural, electronic and retail signage, Zimmermann Industries helps businesses maximise brand visibility and create lasting impressions. Known for innovation, quality craftsmanship and reliable service, the company has successfully delivered outstanding projects across diverse industries.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to promote and grow our industrial signage, branding, and fabrication solutions. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, preparing quotations, conducting product presentations, and achieving sales targets. You will work closely with customers to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a proactive approach to business development, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service while driving revenue growth and market expansion.

About the position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of Work: 9 Trade Place, Lilydale, Vic -3140

Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Technical Assessment & Client Consultation: Review client concepts and architectural plans to assess technical needs, recommending the most suitable industrial fabrication methods, materials, and services to achieve the desired outcome. 
•	Commercial Quoting & Estimating: Scope out the true technical costs of manufacturing bespoke products on the factory floor. Prepare, quote, and negotiate accurate pricing for high-end retail and commercial signage projects. 
•	Technical Translation: Act as the technical liaison for the sales team, updating knowledge of our manufacturing capabilities, materials, and competitors' offerings to ensure our quoted solutions are highly marketable and viable. 
•	Production & Logistics Coordination: Factor in the complete lifecycle of the product during the estimating phase, arranging and quoting the delivery of goods, site logistics, and the provision of installation services. 
•	Reporting & Workflow Integration: Prepare detailed estimating reports for operations and sales management to ensure accurate project handovers. Follow up with the production team and clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve any technical problems arising during the build. 
Qualification and Skills
•	Bachelor of Industrial Design (Honors) or a higher degree in a highly relevant technical discipline (e.g., Engineering, Industrial Design). 
•	A Minimum of 1 year of relevant professional B2B experience in sales of industrial design, retail store design, or technical fabrication. 
•	Technical Proficiency: High-level understanding of industrial manufacturing processes, CAD, and how complex concepts are physically built on a factory floor. 
•	Commercial Acumen: Strong foundation skills in product costing, with a willingness to be mentored in the commercial, quoting, and negotiating aspects of the business. 

Interested in the role? Apply for the role if you think you meet the criteria, and we’ll get in contact with you shortly. Only eligible candidates will be contacted.

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy and industrial products business
• Opportunity to develop expertise in solar and energy efficiency solutions
• Career development opportunities within a growing industry

Key Responsibilities
• Promote and sell industrial renewable energy products, including solar panels, inverters, batteries, and related energy solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Identify potential customers and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, customer enquiries, and sales activities.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective commercial clients, contractors, and industry stakeholders.
• Assess customer requirements and provide technical product information and suitable solutions based on customer needs.
• Prepare quotations, sales proposals, product specifications, and technical information for customers.
• Negotiate sales agreements, pricing, and product requirements with customers and suppliers.
• Manage customer accounts and maintain regular communication to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
• Provide advice regarding product features, benefits, installation requirements, and energy solutions.
• Liaise with internal technical and installation teams to coordinate product delivery and ensure customer requirements are met.
• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer demand to identify new sales opportunities.
• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and business opportunities.
• Prepare sales reports and provide updates on market opportunities, customer feedback, and sales performance.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and industry standards.

What We're Looking For
• Relevant qualification in sales, business, marketing, engineering, renewable energy, or a related field OR 
• Minimum five year of relevant experience in industrial product sales, technical sales, or business-to-business sales.
• Experience selling technical products or solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Ability to interpret customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and sales activities.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
• Willingness to develop knowledge of solar energy products, renewable technologies, and industrial applications.

How to Apply
